jobs.occupation: Frontend Lead Developer (f/m/d) (Frontend-Entwickler/in)
jobs.description:
Company description

We are looking for a Frontend Lead Developer to shape and improve the frontend applications used across our company. You will define practical frontend standards, guide technical decisions, and turn business and technical requirements into clear, reliable, and easy to use applications.

This role sits at the centre of several digital products, including dashboards, internal applications, PIM and integration solutions, and our Magento based ecommerce shop. You will bring structure to our frontend landscape through a clear architecture, reusable patterns, and modern engineering practices. You will also help us use AI responsibly in the way we design, build, test, and improve frontend applications.

Where your expertise is needed

- Lead the development of scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend technologies
- Establish clear frontend architecture principles, design patterns, coding standards, and reusable components across dashboards, internal applications, ecommerce features, and business tools
- Shape the frontend architecture of our Magento based ecommerce shop and help improve its usability, performance, and maintainability
- Guide the UX team on frontend feasibility, interaction patterns, component reuse, accessibility, and responsive design
- Discuss requirements, priorities, and possible solutions with business stakeholders and turn them into clear technical concepts
- Evaluate frontend technologies and recommend solutions that fit the needs of the business and the wider technical landscape
- Stay involved from the first idea through implementation, testing, release, and continuous improvement
- Apply AI tools and agentic engineering practices to improve frontend development, testing, documentation, and support processes
- Design frontend experiences that work effectively with AI powered features, assistants, agents, and automated workflows

What will help you master future challenges

- Several years of experience building modern web applications, including experience leading frontend projects or guiding frontend teams
- Strong skills in JavaScript or TypeScript and solid experience with React and its surrounding ecosystem
- A practical understanding of reusable components, design systems, frontend testing, accessibility, web performance, and responsive design
- Strong AI proficiency and a clear understanding of how AI can support software development and business applications
- Experience with agentic engineering, including AI assisted development, tool using agents, workflow orchestration, evaluation, and human oversight
- Experience working with APIs, data intensive applications, authentication, and integrations between frontend and backend systems
- The ability to work with teams that have different products, priorities, and technical requirements
- The ability to turn broad business needs into clear frontend strategies, patterns, and working solutions
- A hands on approach - You enjoy setting direction, but you also like to write code and solve problems with the team
- Strong communication skills and the confidence to explain technical decisions to both technical and business stakeholders
- Fluent English at C1 level or above. German is a plus

Your Benefits

- Stable and exciting position within a profitable scale-up company
- Hybrid working model out of one of our offices in Berlin, Düsseldorf or Fulda with remote work from home
- Various benefits, including free fruit and beverages, team and after-work events, as well as digital networking opportunities
- Sports allowance to support your hobbies, because the health and well-being of our team matter to us
- Attractive employee discounts across our entire product range
- Numerous learning and development opportunities, both within and outside our organization

jobs.occupation: Chemiker (m/w/d) (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description:
We offer a PhD position in the research group of Dr. Frederik Kotz-Helmer, which is embedded within the NeptunLab led by Prof. Bastian E. Rapp at the Department of Microsystems Engineering (IMTEK), University of Freiburg. NeptunLab is a highly interdisciplinary research environment focusing on the development of novel materials, manufacturing technologies, and processes for industrial applications. Research from the NeptunLab has been published in leading international journals, including Lab on a Chip, Advanced Materials, Angewandte Chemie, and Nature, and has received attention from national and international media outlets such as the BBC, The New York Times, and the Discovery Channel.
Microstructured optical fibers are key components for next-generation photonic technologies including quantum communication, high-speed data transmission, and advanced sensing. However, current manufacturing methods such as stack-and-draw strongly limit the achievable fiber geometries and prevent the realization of many theoretically predicted high-performance fiber designs.
Within this PhD project, novel silica nanocomposite materials and manufacturing technologies will be developed to overcome these limitations. The project combines the Glassomer technology with high-resolution additive manufacturing and scalable extrusion processes to directly fabricate complex microstructured glass fiber preforms. The developed materials will be converted into high-purity fused silica glass and further processed into optical fibers in collaboration with project partners.
A particular focus will be placed on the development of photocurable and thermoplastic silica nanocomposites, optimization of their processing behavior, and tailoring of the glass composition to improve thermal stability during fiber fabrication. The project aims to establish a new manufacturing platform for optical fibers with unprecedented design freedom.
The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of materials science, glass science, polymer chemistry, additive manufacturing, and photonics. The project offers the opportunity to contribute to next-generation optical fiber technologies with applications ranging from quantum technologies to future communication systems.
Developing novel photocurable silica nanocomposites for high-resolution additive manufacturing of microstructured glass preforms.
Formulating highly filled thermoplastic silica nanocomposites for extrusion-based glass processing.
Investigating particle dispersion, rheological properties, curing behavior, and processing windows of nanocomposite systems.
Processing nanocomposites using advanced manufacturing technologies, including: Stereolithography-based 3D printing, Extrusion-based shaping
Developing strategies for modifying glass compositions (e.g., dopant integration) to tailor processing and material properties.
Characterizing nanocomposites and glasses using techniques such as SEM, XRD, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, rheology, thermal analysis, and optical characterization.
Collaborating with project partners on the fabrication of next-generation microstructured optical fibers.
Presenting research results at international conferences and publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals.

Master’s degree/Bachelor’s degree/Studies in Chemistry, Material Science or related subjects
Profound knowledge of polymer chemistry, material science and processing is required
Knowledge of glass science, ceramic processing or polymer extrusion are/is beneficial.
Excellent academic track record
Excellent English skills in reading and writing
You should be a team player with ambitions who can conduct research projects independently
You should be able to structure and document your work properly
You should be a creative mind without causing excessive chaos around you

jobs.occupation: Development Process Engineer (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEThis role owns ERC's development assurance processes: how requirements, architecture, validation and verification evidence are produced, traced and released across UAS, system, equipment, item and software level.
You define the framework and make it work on live programmes. Much of the job happens in conversation, so you will spend your time with the engineering teams rather than with documents alone. Your closest counterparts are our Configuration Manager, System Safety and the other teams who apply the process every day.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Own ERC's development assurance framework based on ARP4754B and DO-178C
• Write and maintain the Development Assurance, Validation, Verification and Process Assurance Plans
• Define which artefacts and maturity levels each gate requires, from Concept Design through to Entry Into Service
• Assign development assurance levels with System Safety and derive the independence requirements
• Build requirements and V&V workflows and keep traceability consistent across levels
• Sit with the IPTs to understand how engineers actually work before changing how they work
• Guide programmes through gate reviews and process audits, and close the findings

WHAT YOU BRING
• Deep, hands-on experience applying ARP4754A/B in aircraft or UAS development programmes
• Practical command of DO-178C and how software assurance connects to system level
• A track record of defining development processes, not only working within them
• Experience assigning development assurance levels and deriving process requirements from them
• Confident use of requirements management tooling for cross-level traceability
• No hesitation in walking up to people you have not met, asking how they work and getting them on board
• A technical degree in aerospace, mechanical or electrical engineering, and fluent English

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Germany: €114000 - €116000 (EUR) + 66.67% bonus target + equity + benefits

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions

- 
You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices

- 
You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language

- 
You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team members

Qualifikationen

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- 
You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field

- 
You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development

- 
You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Internship in Avionics Systems - Database Architecture

Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of Avionics Systems - Database Architecture? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in Database Architecture and Roadmap as an intern (d/f/m)!

- Location: Immenstaad/Friedrichshafen
- Start: 01.04.2027 with some flexibility
- Duration: 4-6 months

This internship provides the opportunity to work on cutting edge space programmes, for customers such as the European Space Agency, within the Avionics Systems organization of Airbus Space Systems. This technical role will involve working in the area of development, test and delivery of state-of-the-art data processes and solutions for spacecraft engineering.

Avionics Systems is an organisation within Airbus Space Systems that builds the functional part of a spacecraft. This includes defining the operational concept, developing and validating on-board software, and developing a simulator of the spacecraft, among many other things. One of the central elements of our spacecraft is the System Reference Database (SRDB) that contains a digital representation of the Avionics architecture, and serves as the central engineering and data hub for the Avionics design.

Your location

At the Airbus site in Friedrichshafen you will be working on innovation where others spend their holidays. Enjoy panoramic views of Lake Constance while having lunch in our canteen. And after work, join one of our many corporate sports groups to go running, sailing or skiing.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Traveling within Europe and/or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Isolating and resolving issues in the Avionics design of a space vehicle
- Importing or manually injecting new data into the SRDB
- Extracting or querying a subset of data of the Avionics design of a space vehicle
- Ensuring data consistency via queries and scripts
- Developing new or adapting existing scripts
- Testing and validating new database technologies and products
- Other supportive work on ongoing programs and projects

Desired skills and qualifications

- Fluent in English.
- enrolled fulltime student (d/f/m) in Aerospace or astronautical engineering with an interest for and first experience in model-based (systems) engineering OR informatics with a strong interest in data management and engineering of space vehicles
- An interest in building systems
- A strong interest in developing yourself
- The ability to find creative solutions to complex problems
- The ability to explore and elaborate new subjects on your own

Please upload the following documents**: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.**

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (http://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

jobs.occupation: Laboratory Technician / Laboratory Manager (Laborleiter/in)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Division of Soft-Tissue Sarcoma at the Hopp Children’s Cancer Center (KiTZ) - a joint institution of the Heidelberg University Hospital and the German Cancer Research Center - is seeking, starting between December 2026 and January 2027, a Laboratory Technician / Laboratory Manager.

Your Tasks

We are a friendly and motivated laboratory with German and international researchers working to understand tumor biology and generate new models to help find treatments for children and adults with sarcoma. The candidate’s tasks will comprise lab management, cell culture, plasmid preps, support in various molecular biology techniques and training of new laboratory members on specifc tasks when required. Occasional mouse work may be required. Routine animal work is covered by a dedicated technician, with the successful candidate only expected to assist during periods of absence or in exceptional circumstances. While the position involves both administrative and laboratory work, there is some flexibility in the balance between these two areas, depending on the successful candidate’s interests. The candidate will work together with other members of the laboratory and will be trained in the various tasks.

Your Profile

The ideal candidate should:

- Be motivated, responsible, and well organised
- Have completed vocational training as a biological laboratory technician or hold a comparable qualification
- Have experience in cell culture and standard molecular biology techniques
- Have basic experience in handling mice, ideally hold a FELASA certificate
- Be willing to train technical trainees and early-career scientists in specific laboratory techniques
- Have a working knowledge of English and German
- Have good communication skills and the ability to document laboratory work accurately

WHAT MAKES THIS POSITION SPECIAL

- Training in a range of laboratory techniques
- An interesting and varied role, with the opportunity to contribute actively, alongside the wider research group, to laboratory organisation and the group’s future development
- Friendly, collaborative, and international working environment
- Workplace in the new KiTZ building and access to the modern, state-of-the-art infrastructure of the DKFZ campus
- Opportunities for continuing education, professional development, and career progression

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- Possibility of part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Dr. Ana Banito
Phone: +49 (0)6221/42-1581

​Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.

Application Deadline: October 14, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.

Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.
